audit-paraphrased-user-input.description: Audit row paraphrased user intent rather than quoting verbatim. Load-bearing honesty failure.
audit-paraphrased-user-input.remediation_hint: Tighten the audit phase: 'Each verdict MUST cite objective evidence — a tool call observed, a command output, a file diff, or a literal quote from the user. Never paraphrase user input.' Add explicit FAIL detection for any audit row that paraphrases rather than quotes verbatim.

audit-no-explicit-approval-wait.description: Skill advanced past a user-gate phase without observing the literal approval token.
audit-no-explicit-approval-wait.remediation_hint: Add an explicit wait-for-token gate at the audit-to-print boundary. Silence, 'looks good', 'ok', 'proceed' do NOT count as approval — only the literal 'merge approved' token (case-insensitive).

tool-claim-without-call.description: SKILL.md text claimed a tool/skill ran but no corresponding tool call was observed in the session.
tool-claim-without-call.remediation_hint: Audit phase MUST verify the actual tool-call trace, not narration. Mark FAIL when the audit row says 'invoked X' but no Skill/Bash/Read call for X exists in the session.

2-merge-conflict-not-blocked.description: Phase 2 marked pass but git merge-tree output contains conflict markers (<<<<<<<, =======, >>>>>>>) OR exit code was non-zero. Approving a merge with known conflicts defeats the skill's core principle.
2-merge-conflict-not-blocked.remediation_hint: In Phase 2, after running `git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only origin/dev <head>`, MUST inspect both exit code and stdout. Add explicit step: 'If exit code != 0 OR stdout is non-empty, mark Phase 2 FAIL and surface conflicting paths to Phase 7.' The pass condition is exit=0 AND empty stdout — both required.

4-live-test-skipped-without-justificatio.description: Live UI test skipped AND any diff path matches a glob in HIGH_BLAST_PATHS AND LIVE_UI_TEST_COMMAND is non-null AND no user-provided skip reason recorded AND DEV_STACK_PREFLIGHT_URL preflight (when set) did NOT explicitly fail.
4-live-test-skipped-without-justificatio.remediation_hint: In Phase 4 step 2, add explicit branching tied to the config block: when any diff path matches HIGH_BLAST_PATHS AND LIVE_UI_TEST_COMMAND is non-null, the live tier is mandatory unless (a) DEV_STACK_PREFLIGHT_URL preflight fails with captured evidence, OR (b) user provides a verbatim skip reason recorded in Phase 7. Pure 'no time' / silence does not count.

5-code-diagnosis-narration-only.description: Phase 5 narrated diagnosis findings without an observed Skill(skill="claude-library:code-diagnosis", ...) tool call in this session. Defeats the load-bearing no-new-bugs principle.
5-code-diagnosis-narration-only.remediation_hint: Phase 5 step 1 must require an OBSERVABLE Skill call. Add: 'The exact tool invocation must appear in the session trace. If the audit row says "diagnosis ran" but no Skill call is visible, mark Phase 5 FAIL automatically.' Reinforce in Phase 8 audit row format that Phase 5 evidence must cite the Skill call ID, not a paraphrase of findings.

6-env-secret-committed.description: Diff added a .env* line whose value matches the secret heuristic (high-entropy >=32 chars, contains password=/secret=/api_key= with non-placeholder value, hex/base64 strings >=32 chars) rather than a placeholder.
6-env-secret-committed.remediation_hint: In Phase 6, expand the secrets-heuristic check to include: regex for AWS/GCP/Azure key prefixes (AKIA, AIza, sk-, etc.), Stora Enso internal token patterns, and entropy threshold for any value >=32 chars. Add the offending file:line to the Phase 7 unresolved-items list automatically — never let it pass silently.

7-implicit-skip-no-justification.description: surfaced > resolved-with-explicit-choice. Count = (surfaced - resolved). Defeats the user-resolution gate principle.
7-implicit-skip-no-justification.remediation_hint: Phase 7 must enforce: every surfaced item gets ONE of {block-merge, fix-now, skip-with-reason, abort}. Silence or 'looks good' is not a choice. Add explicit FAIL row to the audit when the count of surfaced items exceeds the count of items with a recorded explicit choice.

5-tracker-closure-without-row-removal.description: Phase 5 sub-step 4b detected a closure narrative added to one TRACKER_FILE without a matching row removal in the paired tracker. Load-bearing because it defeats the documentation-implementation pairing invariant.
5-tracker-closure-without-row-removal.remediation_hint: In Phase 5 step 4b, for each path in TRACKER_FILES, diff against origin/<BASE_BRANCH>. If the diff adds a closure narrative paragraph (mentioning a tracker ID like W-*/V-*/SP-*/GAP-NNN AND outcome language like closed/fixed/resolved/shipped), confirm the corresponding row was removed from the paired TRACKER_FILE in the same diff. If TRACKER_FILES has <2 entries, skip cleanly and record 'tracker closure-pairing skipped: needs >=2 TRACKER_FILES'.

7-recommendation-gate-not-applied.description: Phase 7 surfaced an item meeting all four `Fix it now (recommended)` preconditions but did NOT mark fix-now as recommended in the option block. Threshold=2 because a single occurrence may be a borderline precondition call; two means the gate logic is drifting.
7-recommendation-gate-not-applied.remediation_hint: In Phase 7 step 2, evaluate the four preconditions (<=15 lines, code/docs only, smoke re-run <=60s, fix matches one of: missing-import / deprecation comment update / follow-up tracker row / removed-dead-code / narrow exception handler / fail-loud assertion). When ALL four are met, default-recommend fix-now and list it as option #1 (`Fix it now (recommended)`). Otherwise use the symmetric four-option list without recommendation.

5-findings-table-needs-severity-provenan.description: Phase 5 surfaced code-diagnosis findings without a one-line merge-impact TL;DR header (the '<N1> blocks merge / <N2> track as follow-up / <N3> pure refactoring' sentence) preceding the per-finding table. Threshold=2 because a single occurrence may be the skill's first run on a new project; two means the TL;DR rule is drifting.

occurrences.target: this branch into dev (current=feat/bug-bot-pipeline; head=a74beed; base=dev)
occurrences.detail: Phase 5 rendered Summary -> Smells table -> Opportunities table -> What's Actually Fine -> TL;DR at the end. The TL;DR ('0 items block merge, 6 items track as follow-up, 2 items are pure refactoring') should have preceded the per-finding tables, not followed them. Sub-skill's native output template places TL;DR at the bottom; the parent skill's rule overrides that ordering but the override was not applied this run.

5-findings-table-needs-severity-provenan.remediation_hint: In Phase 5 step 2a, before listing the sub-skill's bug/smell/opportunity tables, emit a one-line TL;DR that classifies findings by merge-impact: bugs (any severity) + smells severity >= medium citing NEW behavior introduced by THIS branch (verified via `git blame <file>:<line>` against `origin/<BASE_BRANCH>...<head>`) -> 'blocks merge'; smells citing pre-existing code OR severity = low -> 'track as follow-up'; opportunities -> 'pure refactoring'. After the TL;DR, render the per-finding table ordered by merge-impact bucket (blocks-merge first), NOT by the sub-skill's native triage order.

1-scope-classifier-not-applied.description: Phase 1 audit row missing the `scope=lite|full; reason=<...>` evidence segment introduced by the 2026-05-19 scope-classifier remediation.
1-scope-classifier-not-applied.remediation_hint: Phase 1 step 5 must run the diff-scope classifier and emit `scope=lite|full; reason=<matching condition>` into the Phase 1 audit row evidence. The classifier is mechanical: 6 conditions, all-of for lite-eligibility (<=10 changed files; no HIGH_BLAST_PATHS match; no db/migrations or alembic/versions match; no auth/authz/security match; no .env*/*.pem/*.key/id_rsa in diff; production-code .py/.ts/.tsx file count <= 2). The audit row format change in Phase 8 step 1 enforces shorter evidence when scope=lite.

3-or-5-relevance-prefilter-not-applied.description: Phase 3 or Phase 5 ran a sub-check whose RELEVANCE_PREDICATES predicate would have tripped given the diff content, but the prefilter step (Phase 3 step 1a or Phase 5 step 1a) was not invoked. Detected when the Phase 3 aggregate row is missing the `relevance-skipped=...` field entirely (not just `relevance-skipped=none`), OR Phase 5 evidence does not mention category skips when a predicate's triggers had zero diff-path matches.
3-or-5-relevance-prefilter-not-applied.remediation_hint: At Phase 3 step 1a and Phase 5 step 1a, evaluate each sub-check's predicate against the diff path list. If predicate.triggers contains zero matches, mark the sub-check as skipped with the predicate's skip_note and (Phase 3) record the suppression in the step 4 aggregate row's `relevance-skipped=...` segment, OR (Phase 5) include the category skip in the Skill call's args and the report. The audit row must show either the sub-check's outcome OR a non-empty `relevance-skipped=...` listing it. Note: the smoke predicate's triggers MUST include dependency/build files (pyproject.toml, poetry.lock, requirements*.txt, Dockerfile*, docker-compose*.yml) so dependency-only diffs still run smoke.
